Name: page_name
Description: Name of the page being viewed

Name: page_url
Description: Full URL of the page being viewed

Name: referrer
Description: The page that referred the user to current page

Name: link_text
Description: Text content of the clicked link

Name: button_text
Description: Text content of the clicked button

Name: button_location
Description: General location of button on page

Name: is_primary_cta
Description: Whether button is the primary call-to-action

Name: action_type
Description: Type of action the button performs

Name: time_to_depth
Description: Seconds taken to reach scroll depth

Name: time_spent
Description: Total time spent on page in seconds

Name: form_type
Description: Type of form being interacted with

Name: field_order
Description: Order of field in the form

Name: time_to_complete
Description: Time taken to complete form in seconds

Name: feature_name
Description: Name of the feature being viewed

Name: link_context
Description: Context where external link was clicked

Name: user_role
Description: Role of the user in the system

Name: interaction_type
Description: Type of interaction on landing page

Name: section_name
Description: Section of page where interaction occurred

Name: timestamp
Description: ISO timestamp of when event occurred

Name: viewport_width
Description: Width of browser viewport in pixels

Name: viewport_height
Description: Height of browser viewport in pixels
